title: Fonts
what: The carried faces: Pretendard in four weights cut to the letters Apple SD Gothic Neo lacks, CaskaydiaCove for monospace, their licences, and the stacks that name them. The files stand in app/assets/fonts.

title: Component library overrides
what: The layer's app configuration: Nuxt UI's icons, colours, motion timing, badges, dropdown widths, dialog placement, safe-area room and writing-box width, and the empty bmoUi settings a host states.

title: Layer configuration
what: The Nuxt layer a host extends: Nuxt UI as its module, the layer's stylesheet, the viewport meta, the dark-first screen mode kept in a cookie, and the ground painted before the stylesheets arrive.

title: Stylesheet and design tokens
what: The layer's stylesheet: the reading width, header height, screen and safe-area tokens, motion, focus, the palette grounds, badge ink, markdown code styles, keyframes and scrollbars, as docs/design.md states them.
